text:
maria: Deploy bot put the staging promote on hold — failing job `ci/e2e-postdeploy`.
deploy-bot: Promote paused for ref 2026-03-canary (deploy/1299) due to failing job: `ci/e2e-postdeploy`.
jon: Quick look at e2e logs: migrations fail with `exec: "/app/bin/migrate": not found` during post-deploy step. Image entrypoint can't find the binary.
ashley: That's odd. The build logs show `COPY --from=builder /workspace/out/bin/migrate /app/bin/migrate` succeeded in the build stage, but the final image layer size is ~28MB smaller than the last good one.
kevin: I pulled both digests locally. The bad image's /app/bin directory is empty. Suspect `.dockerignore` might be excluding the output directory on the final stage context, so the copy copies nothing into context during docker build --squash or similar.
jon: I grepped the repo: `.dockerignore` had `out/` entry added in a recent cleanup PR (gh#4821). That would hide build artifacts from the final stage when using the local context copy pattern. CI builder previously used a different path so it slipped.
maria: Options:
- pin to previous known-good image and promote now (fastest)
- rebuild with corrected .dockerignore and `--no-cache` then promote (delays ~20-30m)
- emergency patch in staging to copy artifact from an artifact bucket (risky)
ashley: I'm leaning to pin to previous tag to keep change window. We can schedule hotfix build ASAP and replace the image after QA.
jon: Agreed. I'll open an infra ticket to revert the `.dockerignore` change and add a CI guard that fails if expected artifacts are missing from the final image.
kevin: I'll prepare the rollback/pin command and watch canaries after promote.
ashley: Pinning steps (running now):

```bash
# pin to last good digest
IMAGE_REF=redwood/service-api@sha256:1b2c3d4e5f6a
export IMAGE_REF
# force promote with change window label
deploy-bot promote --ref "$IMAGE_REF" --change-window="critical"
```

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @jon: `ci/build#6842 --no-cache --dockerignore-fix` (queued).
jon: Ticket opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2199 ".dockerignore exclusion hides build artifacts from final image; add CI assert".
maria: Please update release notes and ping support/sales channel about the pinned promote and follow-up hotfix.
ashley: Done 8077; promoted pinned image, release notes updated under docs/release-notes/2026-03-20.md with entry: "Staging promote pinned to previous image due to missing migrate binary caused by .dockerignore exclusion; hotfix rebuild scheduled." Canaries healthy for now.
kevin: Monitoring canary metrics and health checks; will rollback if we see regression.
maria: Closing the hold. Thanks everyone. We'll coordinate the hotfix deploy once CI build completes and artifact presence is validated.
